title: Causality Is Key to Understand and Balance Multiple Goals in Trustworthy ML and Foundation Models
findings: The paper does not contain any analysis or findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on the application of causal methods to address trade-offs in trustworthy AI principles like fairness, privacy, robustness, and explainability, using examples primarily from domains like race and gender.
